note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Next-Opus market firmed again: ~90% by Jul 31 (up from 79%), 68% by Jul 24, 95% by Aug 31, 98% by Dec 31; single-day peak ~Jul 23 (38%), Jul 27 at 20%. Fits Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence; exact version unannounced.

Jul 21 Google shipped three Flash models but reconfirmed 3.5 Pro is still in partner testing — a fourth missed target, citing internal performance goals. Markets lean early August after it missed Google's own quality bar.
Polymarket eased slightly: 87% by Dec 31 (from 88), 71% by Sep 30 (from 75), <1% by Jul 31. OpenAI's near-term line still runs through GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) and GPT-Live voice.
V4-Pro/Flash have been open-weight previews since Apr 24. Trackers cite a Jul 24 'stable release,' also the deepseek-chat/reasoner API-alias retirement date — no confirmed GA and no dated market.
xAI (now SpaceXAI) shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term (~16% before Sep). The 6T V9-foundation model reportedly still training on Colossus 2.
Google confirmed Jul 21 it has begun pre-training Gemini 4, the next-gen flagship after 3.5 Pro. No date or dated market yet.
